# Anything Visual

> Anything Visual is the freelance working name of Alaa Belghith, an independent Houdini FX and 3D artist based in Tunis, Tunisia. This site is his portfolio and creative technology lab.

## Portfolio
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/ — Houdini FX, product CGI, motion, and AI-assisted video.

## Project pages
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/16-neuvieme/ — DOOH campaign films for 16 Neuvième, a Tunisian dynamic-display company.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/candles-and-chocolate/ — Full brand package: identity, 86 applications, product visuals and ad films.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/maison-turki/ — Unsolicited gift-box prototype: 421 pastries isolated by an AI pipeline, then filled piece by piece.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/la-palmera/ — Launch campaign pitch for a nightclub: one night, three worlds.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/acr-advertising/ — 2D animation on the series Wled El Bhar, broadcast on Nessma for Ramadan 2020.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/fashion-mirror/ — AI fitting-room kiosk: see yourself in a garment in under 20 seconds, on the shop's own PC.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/human-generator/ — Free Houdini tool: real-unit bodies with text-to-motion, Apache-2.0.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/wheel-builder/ — Procedural Houdini HDA that builds a wheel from two independent outputs, alloy and tire.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/football-tunisia/ — Every Tunisian Ligue 1 crest knitted stitch by stitch by one Houdini asset, free under MIT.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/live-ai/ — Real-time AI visual engine: 1280×720 at 60 fps on a single GPU, offline.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/seat-view/ — Pick a seat and see the show from it: 20 cinema halls and the Roman theatre of Carthage.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/world-window/ — Head-tracked window: Three.js off-axis projection, MediaPipe head tracking.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/personal-and-spec/ — Spec product films, Houdini FX studies, and the projects from my master's and my licence.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/fooh-black-friday/ — Kids Store — Black Friday FOOH spec ad for a fictional store.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/body-swap-dance/ — One 19-second body-swap video: a character montage followed by a 2×2 comparison grid.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/work/sapphire-kaftan-film/ — Sapphire kaftan fashion film: brief, approved board stills, tools and final 30-second video.

## Experiments
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/lab/benchmark/ — Local AI Model Atlas with author-documented workstation tests.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/lab/seat-view/ — Cinema seat-view concept demo.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/lab/seat-view/carthage.html — 3D view of the Roman Theatre of Carthage.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/lab/size-scan/ — Experimental browser-based body-measurement estimate.
- https://alaabelghith.github.io/lab/world-window/ — Head-tracked off-axis projection experiment.
